title: cron results are written to disk but never delivered
evidence: 3 turbo-carnival cron job(s) whose last result was never delivered: tc-growth-harness-brain (43b0d5c4446d, deliver=origin, origin=webui, error=unknown platform 'webui'); tc-weekly-persona-review (8d3ac21799d5, deliver=origin, origin=webui, error=unknown platform 'webui'); tc-ops-triage (9c05f60f5fef, deliver=origin, origin=webui, error=unknown platform 'webui') — the fix is the delivery target on those jobs (`hermes cron edit <id> --deliver <target>`), not this repo.

notes.note: 2026-09-20 18:3xZ ops-triage: unchanged, re-read live in cron/jobs.json. tc-growth-harness-brain (last run 14:05), tc-weekly-persona-review (09-14) and tc-ops-triage are deliver=origin with origin.platform='webui' and last_status=delivery_failed (last_delivery_error "unknown platform 'webui'"); tc-overnight-watchdog (deliver=local) is ok. Re-confirmed the profile's config.yaml configures NO chat platform (the slack/discord/telegram blocks are the empty defaults, allowed_channels/allowed_chats ''), and channel_directory.json lists only homeassistant and email, both empty -- so there is no reachable target to point deliver at. Needs Tim: configure a chat platform for this profile, or accept deliver=local (output stays on disk under cron/output/, where this loop reads it).

2026-09-20 19:5xZ ops-triage: re-verified, and this run pinned WHY it is unfixable from the repo. The three jobs (tc-growth-harness-brain, tc-weekly-persona-review, tc-ops-triage) are deliver=origin with origin.platform='webui'; hermes-agent's Platform enum (gateway/config.py) has no webui member and Platform._missing_ only admits bundled/runtime-registered PLUGIN platforms, so Platform('webui') raises ValueError and the send is skipped before any transport is chosen -- the target can never work. Delivery also has no fallback: the profile's gateway runs exactly one adapter (Signal, per logs/gateway.log) and it is DOWN (cannot reach signal-cli at 127.0.0.1:8080, every 5 min), and no TELEGRAM/DISCORD token exists in master.env. So in this install there is currently NO reachable delivery platform for this profile. Tim's decision: bring signal-cli up and set --deliver signal, or set --deliver local and accept that cron results stay on disk. Deliberately NOT set to deliver=local by this loop: that would flip last_status to ok and paint the board green while delivering nothing (the Acknowledgment!=Resolution anti-pattern).

2026-09-20 20:4xZ ops-triage: unchanged, and it is Hermes config outside this repo. Re-read the live job store: tc-growth-harness-brain, tc-weekly-persona-review and tc-ops-triage are deliver=origin with origin.platform=webui and last_status=delivery_failed; only tc-overnight-watchdog (deliver=local) reports ok. Already verified first-hand that this profile has no 'webui' delivery target (the gateway Platform enum has no such member), so the fix is a one-line change to those jobs' deliver target in the Hermes cron config. Consequence worth restating: every board finding this loop produces is written to disk and dropped -- which is why the board files ARE the record. Needs Tim.
